name: juke-web
description: The React/Vite build for jukeff.com. app.js and the other legacy files still have no build step of their own — copy-legacy-assets.mjs just places them alongside the Vite output so Cloudflare Pages deploys one complete site.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/copy-legacy-assets.mjs
